"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

Thomas Cahill dives deeper into the venture creation model that has made Newpath Partners a force in biotechnology; Tom is a founder, investor and board member across numerous groundbreaking healthcare companies.

At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, get a look inside the future of transportation, technology and innovation with industry leaders Mikell Taylor, Director of Robotics Strategy at GM; Chris Yu, Founder and President of ALSO; Robby Stein, Vice President of Product at Google Search; and Bosco Lai, CEO of Little Place Labs. From robotics and electric mobility to AI-powered search and satellite intelligence, these innovators are exploring how emerging technologies are transforming lives.
Deep dive into the world of international defense and military issues.
Is Prenuvo's $2,500 body scan the future of healthcare? How Aescape's A.I. massage provides tailored relief anytime for everybody.

Explore the allure and rising momentum of gold as an alternative investment, especially as prices soar to all-time highs; from ancient empires to modern portfolios, discover why gold continues to shine as a hedge against inflation.
Discover the innovators behind NYC's changing landscape, from Central Park to Brooklyn's Domino Park; an inside look inside Soho's high-tech social wellness club.
Hosts robot fights from competitors all over the world.
Deep dive into the world of international defense and military issues.
Cosmetic dentist designs celebrity smiles; new laser zaps unwanted tattoos; Elysium develops "Fountain of Youth" pill.
Many don't know it, but New York is a city that runs on steam; it's one of the few cities that relies on the old technology to heat some of its famous buildings.
New York has some famous bridges; these engineering examples have helped set the tone for how bridges around the world are designed.
New York City might be known as the concrete jungle, but its nearly 30,000 acres of park space have been an ever-present part of this metropolis.
Keeping the lights on in New York City is no easy task; as New York moves towards a greener future, the manner of generating electricity will have to evolve.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money podcast, Jeremy Schneider of Personal Finance Club explains how Trump Accounts work, who should open one, how they compare to 529 plans and custodial accounts (UGMA/UTMA), and why they may become.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money Podcast, hosts Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench sit down with Cody Berman to uncover how he achieved financial independence before age 30 and built a $5 million net worth through entrepreneurship, side hustles.
Eleven Madison Park leads the plant-based culinary revolution; Le Poisson Rouge reimagines the indie music scene; Air Company introduces the future of fuel.
Why office-to-apartment conversions are booming; infinite machine builds EV bikes for cities; inside Tribeca Immersive's AI judgment booth.
New York is known as one of the rattiest cities in America with an estimated population of close to 2 million rodents; here is how New York City rats out its rodents.
The yellow taxi cab is the quintessential New York City ride; the threat of ride-share apps and city scandal has left cab drivers to face debt.
Many things come to mind when thinking about New York, but how the city deals with its garbage is usually not one of them; here is how the city hauls away its trash.
New Yorkers create, on average, 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day that makes its way through 7,500 miles of pipes that make up the city's sewer system.
El supervisor de una hacienda trata de deshacerse de una joven mimada, pero se enamora de ella.

José Luis, hijo de un hacendado, decide ir en contra de su familia casándose con Esperanza, una campesina humilde. Su padre lo echa de la casa para oponerse a la boda y porque se enteró de que es parte de la Revolución Mexicana. Unos falsos revolucionarios invaden la hacienda y asesinan al padre de José Luis, y así comienza una cadena de venganzas y tragedias.
Una joven italiana es obligada por un criminal a trabajar en un cabaret donde conoce a un piloto del que se enamora.

Accidentalmente, Tin Tan se relaciona con un pícaro empresario arruinado que lo hace pasar por sí mismo para evitar dar la cara ante sus acreedores. En su nueva personalidad, Tin Tan monta un espectáculo musical con hermosas chicas.
Una mujer acusa falsamente a su tutor, diciendo que la violó porque está enamorada y quiere casarse con él.
Un hombre joven promete a su padrino encontrarles esposos buenos a sus cuatro hijas.
Una joven pierde la razón cuando se entera de que su tío y su novio murieron en un accidente de tren.
Debido a sus celos, un hombre rico aísla de la sociedad a su mujer y la vigila cuando su familia se le acerca.

Un científico nazi, usando la ciudad perdida de Atlantis como su base de operaciones, amenaza con destruir la civilización con una bomba nuclear. El científico nazi quiere que el Tercer Reich empiece a gobernar de nuevo y si sus demandas no se cumplen, él seguirá adelante con su amenaza de aniquilación nuclear. Con muy poco tiempo que perder, Santo es enlistado para encontrar la bomba nuclear, desarmarla y poner fin al plan diabólico del científico nazi.
Un extraño personaje amenaza la seguridad mundial y otro inicia el operativo de rescate contra el hampa.
Un buzo es contratado para buscar una caja de diamantes robados, que se extraviaron durante un accidente aéreo.
Una muchacha de otra sociedad disfruta de sus visitas a bares prohibidos, donde se enamora del dueño de uno.
Tras la muerte de su madre, un hombre acepta viajar a Europa de guía de turistas y se enamora de la jefa de la agencia.
La historia de una prostituta que recorre las calles en busca de clientes a quienes satisfacer no solo físicamente.
Una reseña de la lucha del presidente Benito Juárez contra los conservadores y la intervención francesa.

The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab.

Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer).

While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past.

John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime.

The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.
A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.
A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon.

Given a choice to work for the CIA or go to prison, a notorious hacker (Sam Huntington) accepts the job but turns the tables on his employers by assembling a team comprised of poorly regarded individuals.

Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.

After a plane crash in which both their spouses are killed, Sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck and Congresswoman Kay Chandler's lives are connected. Their spouses were headed to the same address, with identical keys, under Mr. and Mrs. plane tickets. The investigation leads to startling discoveries and an unexpected romance.

At an Army barracks in Hawaii in the days preceding the attack on Pearl Harbor, lone-wolf soldier and boxing champion Prew Prewitt (Montgomery Clift) refuses to box, preferring to play the bugle instead. Hard-hearted Capt. Holmes (Philip Ober) subjects Prew to a grueling series of punishments while, unknown to Holmes, the gruff but fair Sgt. Warden (Burt Lancaster) engages in a clandestine affair with the captain's mistreated wife (Deborah Kerr).

During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. After the two larger lions are shipped off to a zoo in the Netherlands, the smallest of the three, Elsa, stays with the couple. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo.

In this biopic, waitress Jeanne Eagels (Kim Novak) is desperate for fame and joins the carnival to try to achieve it. Under the watchful eye of impresario Sal Satori (Jeff Chandler), Eagels becomes a dancer -- a position that eventually brings her to New York City. With her heart set on filling a Broadway marquee with her name, Eagels takes acting lessons and earns a job as an understudy for a big production. But what she really wants is the starring role -- and she'll hurt anyone to get it.

At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

When he's fired from his job at the railroad, Carl Buckley (Broderick Crawford) asks his wife, Vicki (Gloria Grahame), to pay a visit to his boss, Owens (Grandon Rhodes), to try to earn his sympathies. It works, but Carl then assumes that Vicki and Owens are involved romantically, so he murders his boss in a jealous rage. Sick of her husband's violent ways, Vicki seduces Jeff (Glenn Ford), another worker at the railroad, hoping that she can convince him to murder her husband.

Joey Evans (Frank Sinatra) is a philandering San Francisco-based singer with big dreams of starting his own nightclub, Chez Joey, but chasing women keeps him even more occupied. Despite making a meaningful connection with lovely chorus girl Linda English (Kim Novak), it doesn't stop him from seducing the wealthy widow, and ex-burlesque dancer, Vera Simpson (Rita Hayworth), who he hopes will bankroll his club. Ultimately, Joey has to decide who -- and what -- he most wants in life.

Jenny Marsh is a hard-luck dame who's just finished five years in the slammer for killing a man. Jenny's not exactly the murdering type -- she did the deed while defending her jailbird lover, Harry, which is probably one reason she's attracted the attention of her parole officer, Griff Marat. In fact, Griff is so taken with Jenny that he gets her a job caring for his ailing mother, but although Jenny tries to fly right, she's not yet over Harry.

In the wake of a bank heist, Paul Sheridan is part of a team of cops assigned to recover the stolen $200,000. They stake out the apartment of Lona McLane, the girlfriend of one of the robbers, and before long Paul and Lona begin a steamy affair. Lona persuades Paul to kill her boyfriend so that the two of them can escape with the money, but, in order to pull it off, Paul first has to trick his boss and fellow detectives.

In Frank Capra's acclaimed romantic comedy, spoiled heiress Ellie Andrews impetuously marries the scheming King Westley, leading her tycoon father to spirit her away on his yacht. After jumping ship, Ellie falls in with cynical newspaper reporter Peter Warne, who offers to help her reunite with her new husband in exchange for an exclusive story. But during their travels, the reporter finds himself falling for the feisty young heiress.

Sailors Joe (Dick Haymes) and Skip (Ray McDonald) habitually take advantage of their shipmate, Moby (Mickey Rooney), who's robbed after they take him to a shady bar. When they have no money to go to Catalina Island, Calif., Joe arranges their travel by volunteering the clueless Moby to work on the ship. Skip later meets a glamorous dancer (Peggy Ryan), while Joe woos a nightclub owner (Jody Lawrance). Moby decides to leave, but finds himself coming to the rescue of a beautiful heiress.

When the idealistic young Jefferson Smith (James Stewart) winds up appointed to the United States Senate, he gains the mentorship of Senator Joseph Paine (Claude Rains). However, Paine isn't as noble as his reputation would indicate, and he becomes involved in a scheme to discredit Smith, who wants to build a boys' campsite where a more lucrative project could go. Determined to stand up against Paine and his corrupt peers, Smith takes his case to the Senate floor.
A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.

The luck of Pat Brennan (Randolph Scott) is about to go from bad to worse; after gambling his horse away, he gets a ride from Willard (John Hubbard) and Doretta Mims (Maureen O'Sullivan). Soon, their stagecoach is hijacked by a trio of merciless bandits, led by the especially heartless Frank Usher (Richard Boone). As Usher holds the coach passengers hostage, Brennan falls in love with Doretta and develops a risky plan to free himself and the Mimses, leading to a bloody final standoff.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.
Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.
An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.
Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.
A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.
A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.
One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.
Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
Una joven y su familia desperdician el agua, el hijo más pequeño les pide que ahorren el agua, pero no lo escuchan. Por accidente su casa se incendia y no tienen agua para combatir el fuego.

Gloria es la niña más inteligente de la escuela, pero también es muy insegura y soporta el bullying en su escuela. Un día ella conoce a Poncho, y le ayuda a salir de esta circunstancia, mejorando también la relación que tenía con su mamá.

Un hombre y su hijo se mudan a un nuevo vecindario, cuando conocen a sus vecinas tratan de seducirlas y jugar con sus sentimientos, pero después de un tiempo se dan cuenta de que el amor y el respeto son lo más importante.

Un chico se da cuenta de que un hombre quiere conquistar a su mamá y le pide que se aleje de ella. Un día el hombre trata de abusar de su mamá, ella logra escapar, lo denuncia y le promete a su hijo que no volverá a mentirle.
Una joven sufre de violencia familiar. La joven está harta de la situación en la que vive y trata de convencer a su madre de que huyan de su casa.
Una chica tiene una pésima relación con su madre. La madre se pone mal y corre a su hija de la casa. La chica sale a la calle y se encuentra con su prima quien fomenta el reencuentro.
Un hombre que engaña a su esposa, sale con su amigo sin saber que sus intenciones son malas y que está enamorado de su esposa.

Una señora es asaltada por tres hombres que la golpean en la espalda dejándola paralítica, su hijo trata de defenderla, pero también es golpeado por ellos. El joven comienza a tomar clases de kung-fu para vengarse de los asaltantes.

Jorge es un joven rebelde que no respeta a su madre. Un día se mete en problemas por culpa de su novia. Pero la vida le da una gran lección al perder a su abuela, la única persona que siempre lo apoyó incluso para que él naciera.
Don Tomás sufre un infarto y despierta en un hospital, el señor que lo llevó le dice que es su hijo y le reclama por abandonarlo a él y a su madre. Pero pronto, Isabel descubre que todo es mentira.
The investigation of two murders leads from the Playboy mansion to Wall Street.
The manhunt for Colton Harris-Moore, whose international crime spree made him an unlikely folk hero.
Updates on the death of an anesthesiologist's wife.
A global search for a doctor begins after his wife's untimely death.

Police dispatcher Shawna Nelson thought she had committed the perfect crime when she shot her romantic rival Heath Garraus' execution style, but she underestimated the abilities of the very police department she worked for.
NFL star Kellen Winslow II seemingly had it all when he left the game behind, but five women came forward to accuse him of rape and other sex crimes.

When three high-schoolers are gunned down in their car, police launch an investigation into why they came to such a violent end; ten years later, that investigation reaches a dramatic conclusion in an Albuquerque courtroom.

Girly Chew had been worried about her safety; the investigation into her disappearance would take police into a world of aliens and reptiles, cancer cures and cannibalism, a world inhabited by a charismatic conman and his extra-terrestrial soul-mate.
A woman's ex-husband, wearing a Santa suit, kills nine people at a family Christmas party and sets the house ablaze.
A man arrested at his bachelor party says he murdered his friends because his marriage expenses were getting out of control.
After a doctor's wife is found dead in her bathtub, a toxicology report reveals lethal levels of painkillers; at trial, the doctor's dark side comes out.
Eighteen years after a teen's murder, there is a DNA match, and police have their killer.
A child's comment leads police to find the remains of nine young women at Fred and Rosemary West's Gloucester, England, home.
A relative's traffic violation helps police to find the murderer of a teen girl, 25 years before.

In a modern-day tale of Romeo and Juliet with a Florida twist, high schoolers Courtney Schulhoff and Michael Morin find solace in each other amidst a tumultuous family life; when their families force them apart, the couple's desperation turns deadly.

In the peaceful village of Essex Junction, Vermont, Michael Durenleau's life is cut short with a knife through the heart in the darkness behind Veronica's Tavern after celebratory drinks with his wife Rebecca.
In a case that shocked the nation, a mother and son stand trial for the unthinkable; Shanda Vander Ark, once a promising law clerk, now faces murder charges in the death of her own child.

Terri Gilbert said she didn't know who was coming down the basement steps; she shot and killed him; turned out to be her husband whom she was divorcing; twenty years earlier, she told a similar story, about her first husband.
When Kathryn Hauser was found brutally murdered in her Albuquerque home, friends and family immediately thought it was her estranged husband; but the DNA points elsewhere.

John Harper terrorized his neighbors on Dictionary Hill; he hurled curses, threw stones and drove cars off the road; when local police failed to stop him, one resident took matters, and a pistol, into his own hands.

In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

She's one of the most camera-friendly killers in true crime history. A glamorous Texas social climber turned convicted black widow. Celeste Beard Johnson has done many television interviews, flashing a smile as she proclaims her innocence and pleads for sympathy. But she's never been questioned by David Scott. And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.
A fight between a married couple ends in gunfire.
Officials suspect a man ran his daughter down in an Arizona parking lot in order to restore his family's honor.
A marshal plans to rid the town of undesirables, including Maverick.

Private detective James Barlow (Randolph Scott) is sent to Indiana to infiltrate the ranks of the four Reno Brothers (Denver Pyle, Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Myron Healy), a gang running roughshod over luckless locals. After attracting the Renos' attention with a staged train robbery, Barlow gets in deeper when he strikes up a romance with their sister, Laura (Mala Powers). Gradually, Barlow devises a strategy to set the brothers up for ambush in another train robbery.

The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

Before plantation wife Kathy Summers (Barbara Payton) can run off with her lover, Clay Clayburn (James Craig), civil war breaks out, and he must report to the Confederate Army. However, within a few years he returns to Georgia, and Kathy is still in her old home -- which the Union Army, led by Clay's best friend, Maj. Will Denning (Guy Madison), is using for a base. Kathy begins spying for Clay, but she struggles with the idea that one of these two friends may kill the other in battle.
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.
Divided by the Civil War, two brothers (Ronald Reagan, Bruce Bennett) reunite against Apaches in Arizona.
Bret and Bart accept a countess's pearl necklace as loan collateral.

After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.
Cheyenne is forced into a gunfight with the Laverson brothers, leaving one dead and one out for revenge.
A new neighbor of the McCains' gives Mark a job on his ranch.
A killer's rich father tries to bribe witness Lucas.

Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. Expecting the worst, she brings her young daughter to safety and travels to the home of Dan Frost (Joel Edgerton), a boozing ex-lover who may be her only hope. With Dan now on her side, Jane prepares for a showdown with the vengeful John Bishop and his gang of thugs. Looking to settle an old score, Bishop must now contend with the gun-toting Jane and her new partner.
When a young dockworker is found dead, the team discovers that there are mob connections; Jane tries to avoid sensitivity training; Maura starts spending time with Jane's brother.
A serial killer claims to have clues about the murder of another prisoner; Frankie Jr. prepares to take the detectives exam.
When an ex-boyfriend starts stalking her, Angela turns to her devoted husband, Keith, for protection, but no matter what she tries, she can't seem to shake the stalker who is ruining her life.
Two students and a professor make it through a massacre at Virginia Tech University; A Minneapolis school bus carrying 52 children is on a bridge when it collapses.
A woman plays dead after her boyfriend chokes and shoots; a man gets stuck in a frozen stream while snowmobiling; a federal prosecutor is abducted.
Complications arise when a woman suggests that she and her neighbor kill each other's husband.
A woman (Sheryl Lee) who gives sanctuary to battered women becomes the prime suspect in the murders of abusive husbands.
A Chicago state attorney (Victoria Pratt) has a one-night stand with a suspect in the murder of a city councilman.
A private investigator (Stacy Grant) tells a woman (Alexandra Holden) a shocking secret about her husband (Paul Johansson).
A young divorcee learns that her new home was the site of a murder and that the killer may still be in the neighborhood.
After a series of mysterious events, a woman starts to suspect there may be more to her father-in-law's death than just a simple accident.
A witness agrees to testify against a gang member after a community activist is gunned down; TV host Bill O'Reilly criticizes the police department.
A bank manager is shot during a robbery; Jane's brother may face more trouble as his relationship with Maura begins to grow.
A former classmate is found dead at Jane's high school reunion; Korsak gets a visit from his ex-wife; Jane's old flame returns.
The mother of a performer is stabbed to death at a dance competition; Korsak's stepson is accused of shooting a police officer.
Jane and Maura investigate a warehouse fire; Gabriel Dean hopes to rekindle his relationship with Jane.
Jane and Maura's friendship is strained after the shooting of Maura's biological father; Jane's relationship with Agent Dean is exposed.

In a small town in Maryland, a daughter becomes a suspect when her father is found murdered; police must sort through a tangled web of lies and manipulation when a woman's husband is murdered after she openly engages in an affair with a teenager.
A wife manipulates her daughter in a plot to kill her husband; two teens begin a secret love affair filled with sex, drugs and murder.
A young victim of bullying is pushed to his limit; a young serial killer stalks the streets of Warwick, R.I.
When a privileged girl convinces her friends to do bad things, the community is shocked; Marlene Olive convinces her boyfriend to end her problems.
Two runaways find themselves on opposite ends of a dark satanic ritual in rural Georgia; a boy claims the devil told him to murder his parents.
After a young boy is abandoned by his parents, he begins to have dark urges; a disturbing social media message leads to a murder investigation.

When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August 1986, residents of Tacoma, Wash., panic; convinced a predator is on the loose, police embark on a 32-year inquiry to catch the killer.

Landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006; though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they, along with Bruce's brother Ed, spend the next nine years searching for answers and a killer.

When 30-year-old mother Lisa Gaudenzi fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL; her family immediately suspects foul play, so they embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but Brenda's older sister Linda vows to solve Brenda's murder, no matter how long it takes.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Mich., wonder who would murder this pillar of the community; it will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

When Chris Green, 19, is found beaten to death in a snowy Bangor, Michigan, ditch in 2002, his family fears their son's murder will never be solved; years pass before shocking revelations from an informant emerge and blow the case wide open.
German Shepherd Charlie reaches the mandatory retirement age for police service; during one of his final shifts with PC John Tozer, he tracks and locates a suspect hiding after a robbery attempt.
Excess baggage in the form of six undocumented immigrants is coming in from Calais.
Gang wars and bloody struggles have made Acapulco less attractive for foreign tourists; members of special anti-criminal unit risk their lives every day to maintain security.

Ciudad Juárez is a principal trafficking route for migrants seeking a better life and in order to attempt to prevent the illegal crossing of the USA border, Special forces of the Mexican Federal Police patrol the area for suspicious activity.
London's dog squad is back in action as a stabbing brings together two of London's top German Shepherd dog teams: PC Paul Caruana and Merlin and PC Andy Miller and Nelson.
Wedding season means out-of-control bachelor and bachelorette parties.
Costumed crazies crash and burn; the team has its hands full.

Blanca y Fátima hablan con Esmeralda para convencerla de alejarse de José Armando y ella, conmovida por sus palabras, les promete no buscarlo. Sin embargo, la insistencia del joven la hace desistir de esa promesa.

La obsesión de Lucio lo lleva a esperar en la casa de Esmeralda, donde encuentra a Fermín, quien lo amenaza con contarle al doctor cuál es el origen de su amada protegida. Dominga, desesperada, trata de decirle la verdad a Esmeralda.

Venus les cuenta a todos que Camilo no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Priscila lleva a cabo sus planes para evitar que Damián mate a Vladímir. Camilo intenta quemarle la cara a Venus, pero Eduardo logra impedirlo.

Eduardo golpea a Camilo al saber que abusó de Aurora. Bárbara idea un plan para evitar que Camilo sea encarcelado. Camilo se molesta al saber que Gonzalo no lo incluyó en su testamento. Artemio descubre que Liliana ha perdido el diario Ana Gregoria.

Carlos le pide a Martina que se case con él. Steve se alegra al saber que Venus ha aceptado formalizar su relación. Bárbara idea un plan para hacerle creer a Gonzalo que es una buena mujer. Miguel comienza a sentir un gran interés por Fernanda.

Eduardo teme que Artemio mate a Liliana. Artemio se molesta al saber que Liliana le entregó su diario a Eduardo. Eduardo descubre que Camilo es el responsable de haber golpeado a Steve. Eduardo le confiesa a Fernanda el amor que siente por ella.

Artemio se molesta al saber que Bárbara lo ha traicionado. Bárbara intenta convencer a Artemio de que libere a Liliana. Bárbara lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Damián. Eduardo teme que Venus intente matar a Camilo.
Victoriano libera a Giuliano. Susanito se entera de que él no puede tener hijos. Rodrigo se pone celoso del nuevo compañero de secundaria de Paloma. Santos decide ayudar a Nano a recordar su pasado.

Santos comienza a planear su fuga de la cárcel. Elvira se entera de que van a operar a Concho del corazón. Susanito, al sentir que no sirve como hombre, termina con Irasema. Giuliano amenaza a Santos con hacerle daño a sus seres queridos.
Giuliano le pide a Justo que le dé 10 millones de dólares a cambio de no hacerle daño a Wendy. Elvira le pide a María que ayude a que su padre acepte que tiene una enfermedad.

Santos comienza a alucinar debido a su encierro en la cárcel. Curtis y Derecho unen sus vidas en sagrado matrimonio. María no quita el dedo del renglón y vive con la esperanza de poder volver a Santos.
María convence a Susanito de no dejar de luchar por el amor de Irasema. Concho teme morir en el quirófano y no poder volver a ver a su familia.

Esmeralda asiste a la casa grande, pero, a su regreso, Lucio le advierte que no se fíe de nadie. Dionisio descubre a su hijo besando a Graciela y lo salva de ser visto por Rodolfo. José Armando quiere casarse y está decidido hacerlo pronto.
Eladio le prohíbe a Julia salir de la casa y le quita cualquier medio de comunicación con Arturo. Después, Eladio le dice a Julia que ahora su padre vivirá con ellos y la cuidará.
Gabriela le pide a Arturo que no se haga la prueba de paternidad que Julia le pidió. Por su parte, Eladio le reclama a Julia por ver a Arturo.
Eladio le dice a Julia que la encerrará de nuevo en su casa, ella trata de huir y se cae por las escaleras. Por su parte, David se entera de que Julia nunca ha amado a Eladio.
David le dice a Eladio que ya se dio cuenta del gran amor que siente por Julia y se disculpa por no haberle creído antes. Eladio le confiesa a David que Julia está enamorada de Arturo.
Nina le reclama a Arturo por no decirle que fue novio de Julia, él le dice que está harto de sus celos y le pide que lo deje en paz. Julia despierta y le dice a Eladio que no quiere quedarse con él.

When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth.

In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

Barnaby tries to find out just who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery - what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

It may be Christmas, but Charlie is given no time to familiarise himself with his new surroundings. Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire. The crimes appear to be inspired by the macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.

When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. However, Simon Bright was not alone - as he was hit on the head before he died. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

Por pedirle a Morris que ponga en su tarea que son paramédicos, Rocko y Ale deben ir a la escuela a dar un curso de primeros auxilios. Llegan nuevos vecinos al departamento 301.

Como Lorena no incluyó a Magda en su ahorro colectivo, ella hará una propia. ¿Podrá convencer a los vecinos de entrar a su ahorro y abandonar la de su vecina? Germán no atiende la puerta del edificio como los vecinos se lo han pedido.
Luis le pide a Silvita que deje de hablar con su ex, pues se siente incómodo, sin sospechar que Maru, ex de Luis, llegará a la puerta de su casa. Además, la obra de arte de Jorjais.
Todos se olvidan del cumpleaños de Germán, a pesar de estar invitados a la fiesta. Lorena y Frankie le dicen a Benito que volverá a los castings.
Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.
La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.
Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.
Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

María de Todos los Ángeles es una mujer que siente que se está haciendo vieja sin haber encontrado el amor de su vida. Ella tiene un sueño en el que los ángeles anuncian que pronto el amor de su vida va a llegar.
María decide provocar un encuentro con Albertano para verlo directamente a los ojos y descubrir si es el amor de su vida. La vida de Albertano corre peligro y María se arriesga para salvarlo.

Carmelo queda encerrado probando la alarma del negocio. María sueña que debe ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para conquistar a Albertano, y para eso prepara unos deliciosos chiles, aunque esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.
María quiere celebrar su fiesta de quince años, pero para eso utiliza dinero que no es suyo. Doña Lucha entrena al Chino para ser chambelán. Albertano se ofrece a ser el chambelán de María.
La euforia por el feng shui y por limpiar desata un conflicto entre familias. Doña Lucha y María intentan controlar a todos con el feng shui, y organizan un concurso.
En su búsqueda por trabajo, Albertano es contratado por María de todos los Ángeles, pero sucede una tragedia que Rosa Aurora tendrá que arreglar.
Vítor y Albertano están muy preocupados porque Don Nacho está desaparecido y comienzan una investigación para dar con el paradero del quinto inquilino de la casa.
Héctor opera a Teresa y logra estabilizarla. Aída le reclama a Mariano por preocuparse por la salud de Teresa. Mariano termina con Aída porque nunca va a poder amarla.

Arturo le pregunta a Héctor si es verdad que Teresa podría quedar cuadripléjica y él se lo confirma. Aurora le cuenta a Héctor que se casará con Martín. Aída va a ver a Teresa al hospital y le dice que está paralítica.
Arturo le dice a Teresa que buscará a los mejores médicos para que la curen. Genoveva contrata a Fito para que se robe al hijo de Esperanza. Genoveva descubre que Fito es el asesino de su hijo.

Teresa es inducida al coma para poder ser operada y retirarle la bala que tiene en el cuello. Fernando le cuenta a Oriana que él compró la casa de Arturo para dársela a él y Teresa. Rubén sale de la cárcel.

Oriana le dice a Teresa que Arturo vendió su casa y que Fernando la compró para Luisa. Teresa le agradece a Mariano por salvarle la vida. El parto de Esperanza se adelanta porque Rubén la alteró con su visita.

Hugo, dolido al saber que Mili y Alejandro pasaron la noche juntos, se alía a Andrea para ponerle una trampa a Mili. Con ayuda de Hugo, Andrea finge que Mili la empujó de la escalera y se deja caer. François trata de matar a Constancio.

Hugo convence a Alejandro que Mili sí empujó a Andrea y él le pide que deje la mansión. Constancio exige que Mili se haga pasar por la esposa de Alejandro ante los Betancourt. Andrea vuelve a fingir que Mili la atacó.

Alejandro trata de acercarse a Mili, pero dolida lo rechaza diciéndole que lo odia. Bobby y Rocky encuentran a la esposa de Sergio y Valeria detiene la boda. Luciana descubre que Mili es la hija de Constancio.

Luciana trata de hacer quedar mal a Mili frente a Constancio, pero Braulio arruina su plan. Mili escucha a Andrea confesarle a Damián que nunca estuvo embarazada. Andrea pone a Alejandro en contra de Mili y no le cree nada sobre el falso embarazo.

Alejandro comienza a dudar de Andrea y la cuestiona sobre el bebé que perdió. En un centro comercial, una mujer distrae a Rocky mientras unos hombres secuestran a Valeria. Damián finge ayudar a Constancio con el rescate de Valeria.

Marianne le dice a Damiana que le tiene que devolver todo a Manuel, que Ramón le va a comprar una finca. Adolfo le confiesa a Delfino que intentó abusar de Matilde y que por eso ella se escapó, pero está arrepentido y quiere darle una explicación.

Manuel recibe el mensaje de Ramón y se lo transmite a Matilde. Delfino le pregunta a Adolfo el motivo del duelo con Márquez y él le responde que está harto de tanta podredumbre y que ojalá gane el ejército de Álvarez.

Adolfo y Matilde se encuentran; él le pide perdón y le promete ayudarla a recuperar a su hijo. En casa de Fuentes Guerra, Ramón e Yves tienen un enfrentamiento, Yves dispara y Ramón resulta malherido. Yves intenta huir.

Sixto le informa a Manuel que su hijo ya fue devuelto, Manuel le pide que lleve a Matilde y a su hijo para despedirse de ellos. El gobernador le ordena a Adolfo llevar a cabo la ejecución de Manuel en dos días.

Manuel y Matilde se encuentran; él le pregunta si tuvo algo que ver con la decisión de Adolfo de ponerlo en libertad y ella, llorando, le dice que le prometió irse con él si lo salvaba. Manuel se despide de sus amigos y le jura a Matilde regresar.
Raquel le confiesa a Gabriela que su verdadera hija es Ruth y no Sofía. Ruth salva a Don Agustín y le pide que sea muy feliz con Santita.
Gabriela nombra a Ruth como su única heredera. Gabriela le confiesa a Ruth que ella fue la responsable de la muerte de su madre. Rigo presenta a su hijo a toda su familia y amigos.

Ricardo acepta que él fue quien asesinó a los padres de Juan. Gabriela enfurece al saber que don Agustín le vendió a Juan parte de la hacienda. Gabriela teme que Ricardo la traicione y delate sus malos actos.

Pablito descubre a Ricardo en la hacienda robando. El Coyote le ofrece su casa a Raquel para llevar a cabo sus planes y poder destruir a Ricardo. Fernando obliga a Ruth a firmar un documento en donde le hereda la hacienda.
Óscar enfurece al ver que no puede caminar. Ricardo le confiesa a Ruth que Gabriela es su verdadera madre. Juan salva a Gabriela al ver que su camioneta no tiene frenos.

Rodrigo y Gaviota pasan su último día juntos en la playa antes de regresar a la ciudad. Minerva le aconseja a Isadora que recupere terreno con los Montalvo. Rodrigo llega a casa de Gaviota antes del año nuevo para decirle que la ama.
Los Montalvo se reúnen para festejar el año nuevo. Gaviota y Rodrigo festejan el año nuevo a la distancia, mientras que Isadora continúa tratando de llamar la atención de su esposo.

Rodrigo le condona la deuda al padre de Isadora. Sanjuana no puede perdonar a Hilario el haberla confundido con Isadora. Rodrigo y Gaviota comienzan a planear su viaje, mientras que Minerva investiga si ellos estuvieron juntos en Manzanillo.
Francisco coquetea con Sofía y ella parece corresponderle. Rodrigo y Gaviota se preparan para dejar el corporativo. Isadora escucha a Mariana cantando y descubre que es Gaviota.
Los Montalvo creen que Rodrigo y Gaviota van a escapar juntos y buscan arruinar sus planes. Aarón hace que Rodrigo vaya a la hacienda y lo retienen ahí hasta que deciden qué hacer con Gaviota.
Elena decide terminar con Héctor porque él no fue capaz de defenderla en frente de Rubí; el Conde le confiesa a Maribel que está enamorado de ella y Alejandro va a buscar a Maribel a Las Vegas.

After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.
Tennessee Sheriff Buford Pusser carries a big stick after thugs beat him up and kill his wife.

A turf battle between New York City street gangs that rages from Coney Island to the Bronx. The Warriors are mistakenly fingered for the killing of a gang leader. Soon they have every gang in the city out to get revenge, and they must make their way across the city to their own turf.

Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty.

Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.
Movie, Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure

As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict.

Frank Serpico is an idealistic New York City cop who refuses to take bribes, unlike the rest of the force. His actions get Frank shunned by the other officers, and often placed in dangerous situations by his partners. When his superiors ignore Frank's accusations of corruption, he decides to go public with the allegations. Although this causes the Knapp Commission to investigate his claims, Frank has also placed a target on himself. The film is based on a true story.

Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

Wren (Victoria Justice) is a high-school senior who can't wait to get away from her dysfunctional family. On Halloween, Wren's mother decides to go out with her much-younger boyfriend, leaving Wren to look after little brother Albert. When Wren is distracted by an invitation to the party of the year, Albert disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Enlisting the aid of her sassy friend, April (Jane Levy), and two other classmates, Wren sets out on a frantic search for her sibling.

Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school.

When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship.
A beautiful girl (Ximena Romo) complicates matters between an orphaned shepherd (Christian Vázquez) and his rival (Iván Arana).

A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public.

The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board.

Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

When North Korean ruler Kim Jong-il (Trey Parker) orchestrates a global terrorist plot, it's up to the heavily armed marionettes of the highly specialized Team America unit to stop his dastardly scheme. The group, which includes the thespian-averse technology expert Chris (Matt Stone), not only has to face off against Jong-il, but they must also contend with F.A.G., the Film Actors Guild, a cadre of Hollywood liberals at odds with Team America's "policing the world" tactics.

En ausencia de María José, Lucero llega como invitada especial tomando el papel de juez. Ernesto D'Alessio se mide en el karaoke.

Un programa lleno de sorpresas, música y concursos, en los cuales participan los jueces junto con los pequeños gigantes. Alejandra Guzmán y Moderatto interpretan sus éxitos acompañados por los concursantes.

La noche se engalana con la presencia de invitados como Luis Fonsi, Benny Ibarra y Bianca Marroquín que sorprende al público interpretando una melodía. Los capitanes de cada equipo se enfrentan en una ronda de preguntas para obtener un punto extra.
Pequeños Gigantes llega a su fin con la participación de estrellas como Carlos Ponce, Anahí, Christian Castro y más. Se dará a conocer al equipo vencedor.
Galilea presenta a su hijo y los jueces seleccionan a los participantes de los 7 equipos.
Comienza la competencia y se forman los equipos. Galilea presenta al niño que ha sido el primer lugar en la tabla de posiciones.

On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field; numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced; many maintain their account of the incident is true.
Thousands claim to see a massive triangular craft hovering over Belgium in the late 80s and early 90s.
In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, lands near crucial NATO bases; a group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with colored lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.

Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.
A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.

In the summer of 1952, stories of U.S. Air Force jets chasing UFOs over the White House knock the Korean War off the front pages of newspapers; as rumors spread, President Harry S. Truman demands to know what was flying over his house.

In 1978, UFO enthusiast Paul Bennewitz claims he's intercepted extraterrestrial messages; military officials send counterintelligence officer Richard Doty to feed Bennewitz lies, questioning whether Doty himself is a pawn in an even bigger scheme.

Lt. Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detect and engage with UFOs on multiple occasions; he gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing every day.

A mercenary with a chip on his shoulder, Karl Thomasson poses as a teacher at an inner-city school to exact revenge on the gang members who murdered his brother. As Thomasson investigates the killing and tries to keep his estranged niece, Anya, safe, he begins to realize how dysfunctional and violent the urban school environment has become. Even with support from fellow soldier Joey Six, Thomasson is seriously outnumbered as he seeks vengeance.

The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free.
After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley).

A case of mistaken identity puts a man named Slevin (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a war between two rival New York crime lords: The Rabbi (Ben Kingsley) and the Boss (Morgan Freeman). While under the watchful eyes of Detective Brikowski (Stanley Tucci) and well-known assassin Goodkat (Bruce Willis), Slevin must quickly devise a plan to save his skin before his luck runs out.

The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).

Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. Two weeks after guiding a missionary (Julie Benz) and her comrades into Burma, he gets an urgent call for help. The missionaries have not returned, and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army.

Vietnam War veteran John Rambo tries to find some semblance of peace by raising horses on a ranch in Arizona. He's also developed a special familial bond with a woman named Maria and her teenage granddaughter Gabriela. But when a vicious Mexican cartel kidnaps Gabriela, Rambo crosses the border on a bloody and personal quest to rescue her and punish those responsible.

Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.
Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.
Rob Schmitt wraps up all the latest news and opinion and sets the stage for tomorrow.
Through police bodycam footage, viewers experience the intense moments of a burglary in progress, followed by high-speed chases and the arrest of an officer for DUI.
The human side of policing -- sheds light on the challenges, emotions and ethical dilemmas officers face as they work to protect their communities while confronting their own vulnerabilities.
Flash Wars examines the rise and growing threat of AI-powered weapons, autonomous warfare and surveillance technology.
Despite bans, dangerous chemical weapons are still used by certain regimes. Explore how these weapons are used and how they can possibly contribute to the threat of future biological warfare.
A look at the leadership of Kim Jong-un and North Korea's secretive history, with exclusive interviews with political and historical experts Prof. Natasha Lindstaedt and Dr. Owen Miller.
Evangelical and Protestant Christians have become a prime target under Russia's expanding occupation, enduring seized churches, tortured pastors and abducted children.

A history of UFO's and Presidents, from George Washington to Donald Trump, with expert testimony, interviews, and reports of personal encounters involving U.S. Presidents and unexplained paranormal phenomena.

Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.
Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.
While vacationing with friends, a teenager (Elisabeth Harnois) believes that her dead twin sister is trying to contact her.

Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

Gretta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Gretta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Gretta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Gretta's first album.
A killer (Michael Keaton) terrorizes a blind woman (Michelle Monaghan) in her New York penthouse after murdering her boyfriend.

Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.
A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.
Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

Lizzie's best friend, Andie, becomes pregnant and offers to give the baby to her. Lizzie's husband, Peter, reluctantly goes along with being the child's father, and Andie moves into the guest room for the remainder of the pregnancy.

Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.
Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws.
Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.
In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties.

Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food".

Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.
